task.instruction: Synthesize incident-console findings where common outages follow a repeatable sequence but partial failures require contextual routing.
task.deliverable: A synthesis of operating design, fixed customer-notice trigger, and evidence.

evidence.content: Synthetic reviews include 28 common outages resolved by the same four checks and 9 partial failures spanning cache, permission, and stale-region states.
A synthetic incident-communication rule requires a customer notice once two regions are impaired; operator branching changes recovery handling but not that notice trigger.
A strict runbook cuts common resolution time by 22%; on partial failures it causes three unnecessary restarts unless operators can branch with recorded rationale.

A.content: When repeatability and auditability dominate, make the decision sequence and required checks explicit.

B.content: When conditions vary in consequential ways, preserve bounded judgment to adapt the decision to observed context.

irrelevant.content: Use one capitalization style for all section headings.
